o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (alav), a derivation from Proto-Turkic *yal- (“to burn, blaze; flame”). Cognate with Turkish alev, Uzbek olov, Kazakh алау (alaw).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یینی (yeyni, “lightweight”), یكول (yeŋül), from Proto-Turkic *yeŋil. Cognate with Turkish yeğni, Gagauz ilin.
